company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech serving exporters with business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance. Its work sits at the intersection of financial services, payments and international trade, with a focus on helping clients manage cross-border business needs.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility and learning from problems, and reducing complexity to move quickly for clients. Halden Pay describes its culture as commercially driven, with friendly colleagues and an emphasis on collaboration and personal development. It offers career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring across departments.

Most offices work hybrid, typically with three days a week in the office. Engineering teams are organised around product areas including payments, risk, data platform and client experience. The company also holds team events and regular get-togethers across its roughly 40 offices. Employee reviews are mixed: culture scores are around 3.3–3.4 out of 5, and some reviewers note that onboarding and training vary between teams.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
